# A component built at run time is emitted once for every instance, so which
# boundary an instance sits under is not something its body can know
# statically. A raise such a body lets out, under a boundary, is refused with
# a position rather than emitted going nowhere. bubbletea keeps no state of an
# instance's own and splices each copy, so it resolves each one instead; the
# interpreter follows the render tree at run time.

! sngl generate --platform html --out out app.sngl
stderr 'app.sngl:25:16: a raise in row cannot reach the @error around this instance: row is built at run time here'

! sngl generate --platform android --lang kotlin --out out app.sngl
stderr 'a raise in row cannot reach the @error around this instance'

sngl generate --platform bubbletea --lang go --out out app.sngl
grep 'recover\(\)' out/model.go

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import seq "sngl:seq"

func check(s string) {
    if s.length == 0 {
        error.raise("empty", "validation")
    }
}

component row node {
    var after = false
    button(text="go", @click {
        check("")
        after = true
    })
}

component list node {
    var n = 2
    var problem = "none"
    boundary(@error(e) {
        problem = e.message
    }) {
        for var i = seq.count(n) {
            row()
        }
    }
    text(value=problem)
}

window #home(title="t", href="/index.html") {
    list()
}
